Storyline: This fusion glyph is created when the player combines three glyphs: Glyph of Sorrow, Glyph of Remembrance, and Glyph of Legacy. These three glyphs unlock access to the Triglyph Chamber, a Corelink emotional server housing "The Witnessed Crown" a boss which is a manifestation in a projection that is distorted. The player through wearing a helmet is able to interface with the Corelink system and play out memories of Ravi, Nima and Kaelen related to the three glyphs and help to resolve them. After each round of story play throughs the player transitions deeper. This is shown by the player replaying the memory of them entering the Triglyph Chamber except this time the projection is less scrambled. The player goes through this process three times, ending at last with Ophina's story created through the memories shared by her parents and a photo shown to the player by Nima. The player has a dialogue with Ophina tells the player to convey to her parents not to hang on to the memory of her death. But to hold the love they felt for her in their heart instead.  The boss full resolves and then fades. In its place is projected the Glyph of Contained Loss. Behind the victory console, the player sees a faint vision: young Velinor playing with Ophina in the marketplace, laughing and chasing through the stalls. The player's movement speed is less weighted in their movement now and the chamber door is now reopened allowing them to exit.
